correctness.rationale: From any model larger than k+2^k, after collapsing repeated witness values there are more than 2^u outside vertices but only 2^u witness-neighborhood vectors. Two matching vertices give a two-point induced submodel that can be cloned to arbitrary multiplicity. Every ordered pair in the clone expansion realizes an atomic type over the witnesses already realized before cloning, so the quantifier-free matrix remains true. The injective-profile sentence attains order k+2^k.
